svg.text: Candidate host synthesis of mutton odor-associated fatty acids
MOA / MNA / EOA: primer choice + branched donor choice determine the product
2 Adipocyte cytosol: ACC supplies extension donors
FASN uses these primers / CoA donors; +2 / +3 / +4 are net carbons retained after decarboxylation.
3 Candidate FASN assembly: three extensions → branched acids
Each cycle: condensation → reduction → dehydration → reduction (NADPH) | ACP-bound intermediates; Cn = acyl carbons
Why C4? The final extension adds 2C at the carboxyl end, shifting the existing branch from C2 → C4.
* ACC side reactions, FASN donor acceptance and early release remain unverified in sheep; stereochemistry is unspecified.
ACC, acetyl-CoA carboxylase · FASN, fatty acid synthase · CoA, coenzyme A · ACP, acyl carrier protein
